builds.hypothesis: W5 single-target shot85+0.18AP; one box fires5s. AP/MR modifiers strengthen actual shots; record count rather than guess cadence. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya adds105AP; Riftmaker adds bonusHP-to-AP and8% full-ramp damage. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR and amplify eligible low-health hits. Nearby Abyssal makes target take12% more magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

kitEvidence.formula:
Shaco creates a trap that stealths itself after [2] seconds and lasts for [40 + (0.1) × AP] seconds. It activates when an enemy comes near or when revealed, Fearing nearby enemy Champions for [0.5 / 0.75 / 1 / 1.25 / 1.5] seconds, or [2] seconds for minions and jungle monsters.

Once activated, the trap fires at all nearby enemies for 5 seconds, dealing [10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 + (0.12) × AP] magic damage, or [25 / 40 / 55 / 70 / 85 + (0.18) × AP] damage if focused on a single target.

Jack in the Box's attacks deal an additional [20 / 35 / 50 / 65 / 80] damage to monsters.

builds.name: Two-Shiv Poison: hybrid magic execute
builds.summary: Explore a high low-health Two-Shiv Poison result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.goal: Explore a high low-health Two-Shiv Poison result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 E is 170 + 0.8 bonus AD + 0.6 AP magic damage, multiplied by 1.5 below 30% target HP. Bloodthirster and finite Hubris feed AD while Deathcap/AP and magic penetration feed the other terms. Crit and armor penetration cannot multiply this magic shiv. Backstab eligibility needs its own positional test.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, maximum selected rank unless overridden, game minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 max HP, 100 armor, 50 MR; no allied buffs, dragons or elixirs. Owner full HP. Target at 29% HP, Hubris exactly 10 credited kills with active buff. No box, clone or attack damage. Score a front-facing shiv first; do not grant Backstab silently. Target starts at 29% HP; prior champion combat 0s. Gathering Storm fixed at minute 30; Absolute Focus only above 70% owner HP.

Passive: While this Ability is off Cooldown, Shaco's Attacks Slow the target by [(-0.2 / -0.225 / -0.25 / -0.275 / -0.3) × -100]% for [2] seconds.

Active: Shaco throws a shiv, dealing [70 / 95 / 120 / 145 / 170 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.6) × AP] magic damage and Slowing by [(-0.2 / -0.225 / -0.25 / -0.275 / -0.3) × -100]% for [3] seconds. If the target has less than [30]% Health, the shiv deals [(70 / 95 / 120 / 145 / 170 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.6) × AP) × (1.5)] damage instead.
